Reply to the [review on e42e54249](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3458#issuecomment-7113771055), blocker 1 (the conflict in `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`).

New head: `c7048825c`. It has a merge of main (`3c68dcaf2`) and one new commit.

What conflicted:

- Main (#3349) split the Engrave arm. Engrave uses `machining2d::trace_avoid` when a "Do not touch" spec is set. Trace keeps the plain `trace`, and `avoid::protect_path` judges it after fixture routing.
- This PR joins the Trace and Engrave arms and adds the sketch-stroke path.

How the merge keeps the two behaviours:

- A model pick: Engrave with a spec uses `trace_avoid`. Trace uses `trace`. This is the same as main.
- A sketch pick: the arm cuts the strokes (`strokes.trace`). `trace_avoid` takes closed loops only, so it cannot plan around open strokes.
- Commit `c7048825c`: the final path of a sketch Engrave now goes through `protect_path`, as a Trace does. The links are lifted. A stroke that meets a protected item is refused by name. A sketch Trace already went through `protect_path`.
- The post gate (`live_avoid_problems`) checks all sources, as on main.

Pinning test: `sketch_engrave_trace::avoid::do_not_touch_refuses_a_sketch_stroke_that_passes_too_near_a_protected_face`. It runs Trace and Engrave on a sketch stroke beside a guard block. Without protection, the path cuts and nothing blocks. With a 1 mm clearance, generation refuses with "Do not touch" and the guard name, and the post refuses. When I remove the sketch Engrave judgement, the test fails.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|

| `do_not_touch` (main's Trace avoidance tests) | 7 passed |
